newsitem.title: NORWAY: Falconbridge says Norway plant back to full speed.
newsitem.headline: Falconbridge says Norway plant back to full speed.

text.p: Metals producer Falconbridge said on Thursday it was running at full capacity at its smelter at Kristiansand in southern Norway after production problems in October.
"We had problems in late October and we had to reduce production for a few days but we have been running at full speed since early November," a company spokesman told Reuters.
He declined to comment on how much output was lost during the period.
The Kristiansand facility has an annual capacity of 39,000 tonnes of copper, 69,000 tonnes of nickel and 3,700 tonnes of super-high-grade cobalt.
